rationale: Tests core ILAE classification: focal vs generalised onset — a high-yield distinction that drives AED choice.
Targets the first-seizure evaluation decision point — whether a routine CT head is sufficient or whether MRI is the preferred neuroimaging modality.
Status epilepticus stepwise management with timings is a patient-safety critical item — tests the first-line IV benzodiazepine and the 5-minute operational threshold.
Targets the high-yield AED selection trap: carbamazepine and phenytoin are contraindicated in absence and myoclonic epilepsies — a prescribing-safety item.
